name: 89-seekjump-large-skips
description: 0.3 s render latency. +60 s (in the buffer), +100 s (past the buffer, carried across segments not fetched yet), -80 s (back across several segments before the build start, one rebuild per segment). Skips that cross many boundaries drift by the ~20 ms of Opus padding per segment against the fixture durations, so they are kept under the 150 ms tolerance.
